findings.summary: No declaration states both identities of (8.16); they are separate theorems. The (Z,T)-dependent c_ρ the paper stresses appears only in the SlowRegion-local axial theorem, while the globally quantified axial theorem uses a constant c_ρ.

The Lean hypothesis bundles additionally require the residual stresses Σ_θ, Σ_z to be smooth, shell-supported and torus-periodic. Proposition 8.4's statement lists no hypothesis on Σ_a, though its proof invokes their compact support.

The paper's radial integrals run from 0 to ∞; the Lean moment integrates over all of ℝ. The two agree because each theorem hypothesizes support in a shell [a,b] with 0 < a, but the identification is an encoding choice, not a definitional one.
